sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>true</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>true</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Book A Metro Ticket">08b4611893a303906c8736718bba10b2</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:b12e2dd893e303906c8736718bba10a1</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Fare auto-calculation</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
    if (isLoading) {
        return;
    }

    var source = g_form.getValue('starting_from');
    var destination = g_form.getValue('going_to');
    var passengers = Number(g_form.getValue('no_of_passengers'));
    var journeyType = g_form.getValue('type_of_journey');

    if (!source || !destination || !passengers || !journeyType) {
        g_form.clearValue('amount_for_single_journey');
        g_form.clearValue('amount_including_return');
        return;
    }

    var fares = {
        'Ameerpet|Panjagutta': 20,
        'Ameerpet|Madhapur': 30,
        'Ameerpet|Jubilee Hills': 20,
        'Ameerpet|Kukatpally': 30,
        'Ameerpet|LB Nagar': 50,
        'Ameerpet|Uppal Stadium': 60,

        'Panjagutta|Jubilee Hills': 20,
        'Panjagutta|Madhapur': 30,
        'Panjagutta|Kukatpally': 40,
        'Panjagutta|LB Nagar': 50,
        'Panjagutta|Uppal Stadium': 60,

        'Jubilee Hills|Madhapur': 30,
        'Jubilee Hills|Kukatpally': 40,
        'Jubilee Hills|LB Nagar': 50,
        'Jubilee Hills|Uppal Stadium': 60,

        'Madhapur|Kukatpally': 40,
        'Madhapur|LB Nagar': 50,
        'Madhapur|Uppal Stadium': 50,

        'Kukatpally|LB Nagar': 60,
        'Kukatpally|Uppal Stadium': 70,

        'LB Nagar|Uppal Stadium': 30
    };

    var route = source + '|' + destination;
    var reverseRoute = destination + '|' + source;

    var fare = fares[route] || fares[reverseRoute];

    if (!fare) {
        g_form.clearValue('amount_for_single_journey');
        g_form.clearValue('amount_including_return');
        return;
    }

    if (journeyType == '1') {
        g_form.setValue(
            'amount_for_single_journey',
            fare * passengers
        );
        g_form.clearValue('amount_including_return');
    } 
    else if (journeyType == '2') {
        g_form.clearValue('amount_for_single_journey');
        g_form.setValue(
            'amount_including_return',
            fare * 2 * passengers
        );
    }
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-21 17:26:56</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>b1088a5093e703906c8736718bba1044</sys_id><sys_mod_count>4</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Fare auto-calculation</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_b1088a5093e703906c8736718bba1044</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-27 13:03:54</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

    var sysId = g_form.getUniqueValue();

    var dummyURL =
        'https://example.com/ticket?id=' + sysId;

    var qrImageUrl =
        'https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=250x250&data=' +

        title: "Your Metro QR Ticket — click Checkout once more to confirm",
        widget: "metro_qr_widget",
        widgetInput: {
            qr_url: qrImageUrl
        }
    }).then(function() {
        metroQrDone = true;
    });

    return false; // block only the first Checkout click
